import json, sys, time, resource, subprocess
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace','/workspace/project']
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('guard', '/workspace/child_guard.py')
guard = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(guard)
LIM = {'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
def run(data, label):
    start=time.time()
    p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/launch.py','/workspace/project'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        env=dict(PATH='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/workspace',LANG='C',TMPDIR='/workspace/tmp'),
        cwd='/workspace',preexec_fn=guard.restrict,close_fds=True)
    out,err=p.communicate(data,timeout=170)
    u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print('%-26s in=%9d out=%8d wall=%5.1fs cpu=%5.1fs rss=%5.0fMB exit=%d head=%s'%(
        label,len(data),len(out),time.time()-start,u.ru_utime+u.ru_stime,u.ru_maxrss/1024,p.returncode,out[:70]))
    return out

# 1. 10 MiB single policy in an otherwise valid job
policy = 'match(A) allow;'*700000   # ~10.5MB of characters
job={'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':LIM,'events':[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':policy}]}
run(json.dumps({'jobs':[job]},separators=(',',':')).encode(), 'oversize job 10MB')

# 2. exactly 8 MiB of policy across jobs, atoms over budget
policy2 = 'match(A) allow;'*660000  # ~7.9MB
job2={'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':LIM,'events':[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':policy2}]}
run(json.dumps({'jobs':[job2]},separators=(',',':')).encode(), '8MB one job')

# 3. hostile: one gigantic single path
policy3='match(A'+',A'*1000000+') allow;'
job3={'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':LIM,'events':[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':policy3}]}
run(json.dumps({'jobs':[job3]},separators=(',',':')).encode(), 'gigantic path')

# 4. hostile: unbalanced parens
policy4='('*3000000
job4={'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':LIM,'events':[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':policy4}]}
run(json.dumps({'jobs':[job4]},separators=(',',':')).encode(), 'gigantic parens')

# 5. whitespace-only policy of 8MiB
policy5=' \t\n\r'*2000000
job5={'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':LIM,'events':[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':policy5}]}
run(json.dumps({'jobs':[job5]},separators=(',',':')).encode(), 'gigantic whitespace')

# 6. many events with unbounded nesting inside strings
policy6='match(A) allow;'
job6={'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':LIM,'events':[{'op':'stage','epoch':i+1,'policy':policy6} for i in range(16)]}
out=run(json.dumps({'jobs':[job6]*4},separators=(',',':')).encode(), '4x16 stages total 64')
EOF
